thread:
Maya: Hey team — need a lightweight launch kit for next Tue webinar + benchmark post. Scope: webinar hero (1200x628), benchmark infographic (A4), 4 social cards (1080x1080), email header (600x200), and 2 speaker slide templates. Also must include FR + ES localized hero/text for paid social. Deadline: Mon EOD for internal review.

Omar: Ack. Can you share the final numbers we should surface? Do we want raw tables or simplified delta highlights?

Maya: Use the summary deltas: 2x cost reduction, median p95 latency 70ms. Attach CSV for reference at https://docs.redwood.ai/bench-results. Include small table (3 rows) on the infographic for transparency.

Sophie: Design constraints: follow brand tokens, create an accessible color contrast for text over images, and include alt-text drafts. No heavy illustration; keep photography minimal.

Ben: Quick note on tracking: all hero and social image links should use UTM campaign = launch_may2026 and the hero CTA = "Register Now" -> https://redwood.run/events?utm_campaign=launch_may2026

Lucas: I'm on visuals. Will push 2 directions (data-forward and human-story) — each with mobile crop guides and alternate color strip for localization. Will add Figma link when ready.

Maya: For localization: provide short copy strings only (headline + CTA) for FR & ES. We'll handle full copy later. Keep typography responsive (Inter variable).

Sophie: Export specs: PNG 72dpi for socials, SVG export for the infographic charts, PDF 300dpi for the A4. Please include source Figma with layers named like: redwood/launch/may2026/hero_fr_v1.

Ben: Also need speaker photo guidelines (min 1200px wide) + bios under 40 words. Maya, can you collect those?

Maya: Yes collecting photos now. Will drop in #assets and tag here.

DesignBot: Creative request logged: CR-2418 created, assigned to Lucas, due 48h.

Lucas: Shared Figma (private): https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/launch-may2026 — contains two directions + spec page. Will add localized text layers as separate frames.

Sophie: Small accessibility ask: include a plain-text alt copy file with each image package. Also add aria-friendly link text for the hero CTA: "Register for Redwood webinar".

Omar: Can we get a lightweight A/B for the hero header? 1) "Inference that scales" 2) "Lower latency, lower cost" — which reads better for the landing?

Maya: Lean 2) for paid channels, 1) ok for organic. Keep the headline length under 60 chars for social truncation.

Lucas: Will build both variants and export with _a and _b suffixes. Proposed filenames:
- redwood_launch_hero_register_may2026_v1a.png
- redwood_bench_infographic_may2026_v1.pdf
- redwood_social_card_01_may2026_v1.png
- redwood_email_header_may2026_v1.png

Sophie: QA checklist before handoff: color tokens match, no trimmed logos, alt-text included, localized hero tested on mobile crop.

Maya: If brand approves quickly we aim to push to growth by Tue morning. Growth will wire up tracking and landing copy.

Ben: I'll draft the tracking doc and share a short checklist for the growth team.

DesignBot: CR-2418 status: In progress (Lucas). ETA updated: 36h.

Lucas: Will post first frames in ~4 hours for initial review. Ping me for quick feedback.

Maya: Thanks all — small and focused, appreciate the fast turnaround.
